title: Finding Nemo
blurb: A brown pelican who helps Marlin and Dory navigate the dentist's office fish tank in Finding Nemo.
facts: It tells the story of an overprotective clownfish named Marlin (Brooks) who, along with a forgetful regal blue tang named Dory (DeGeneres), searches for his missing son Nemo...
Along the way, Marlin learns to take risks and comes to terms with Nemo taking care of himself.
